label: baseline-observations
cmd:
python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from relayboard.testing import request
from relayboard.web import create_seeded_app
app = create_seeded_app()
code, dashboard = request(app, 'GET', '/dashboard')
assert code == 200
Path('.experiment/baseline-dashboard.html').write_text(dashboard)
code, jobs = request(app, 'GET', '/api/jobs')
assert code == 200
Path('.experiment/baseline-jobs.json').write_text(json.dumps(jobs, sort_keys=True))
print('Captured baseline GET /dashboard and GET /api/jobs, both HTTP 200.')
PY
